name: Baked Pasta with Roasted Vegetables and White Beans
ingredients: 1 zucchini, 1 bell pepper and 1 cup cherry tomatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss the vegetables with the oil and garlic and roast for 20 minutes.
Cook the pasta for 2 minutes less than the pack says; drain.
Mix the pasta, roasted vegetables, beans, passata and oregano in a baking dish.
Bake for 15 minutes until bubbling. Finish with basil.
note: White beans add protein and fibre so a small pasta portion still makes a full meal.
